configurePresets.description: Native Linux build. Requires: cmake, gcc/clang.
configurePresets.name: linux

configurePresets.description: Linux + ASan/LSan/UBSan on our own targets (P6). Third-party deps stay uninstrumented. Requires X11 dev packages for the SDL native video backend.
configurePresets.name: linux-asan

configurePresets.description: Windows MSVC build. Filament's windows prebuilt (.lib) is MSVC-only; do not use MinGW. The generator is intentionally unset so CMake picks the newest installed Visual Studio.
configurePresets.name: windows

configurePresets.description: Auto-wires the NDK toolchain from ANDROID_NDK_HOME when present (P4); otherwise configures as a host stub with a warning (P0 policy).
configurePresets.name: android

configurePresets.description: On macOS hosts, auto-wires a real iOS cross build (P4). On other hosts, configures as a host stub with a warning (P0 policy).
configurePresets.name: ios

configurePresets.description: Windows cross-compile gate (MinGW-w64 on Linux host). Compile-only: builds the tiles_renderer static library against the Filament windows headers + cesium-native (vcpkg overlay triplet x64-mingw-static in cmake/vcpkg-triplets) to catch windows.h macro / portability issues in minutes. The final link needs MSVC .lib files, so only build the tiles_renderer target here — the MSVC CI job remains the authority.
configurePresets.name: windows-mingw
